<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:14">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עמידת ז׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 670:2">Yalk. Lev. 670</cite> <he>מצות ז׳</he>) the duty of standing up before an old man.

senses.gloss: elder, judge, scholar. Ib. (ref. to Is. III, 2) ז׳ זה שראוי וכ׳ zaken means one fit to sit in college sessions.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 8b:7">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ ששכח וכ׳</he> a scholar who forgot what he had learned, &c., v. <cite ref="A00753"><he>אוֹנֶס</he></cite>.

Kidd. 32ᵇ אין ז׳ אלא חכם under zaken (Lev. XIX, 32) a scholar is meant; Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VII אין ז̇ק̇ן̇ אלא ז̇ה שק̇נ̇ה חכמה a zaken is he who has acquired wisdom (through study).—ז׳ אשמאי, v. אַשְׁמַאי.
Yoma 28ᵇ ז׳ ויושב בישיבה a scholar and member of college. Y. M Kat. III, beg. 81ᶜ איני מכירך ז׳ I shall not recognize thee as (give thee the diploma of) a zaken; a. fr.—Pl. זְקֵנִים.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:1">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>מצות הז׳</he> rabbinical law.
<cite ref="Berakhot 11a:21">Ber. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>זִקְנֵי ב״ש</he> the graduates of the Shammai school; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:32">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>מעשה זְקֵנָן</he> the conduct of their ancestor (Abraham). Pesik. Zakh., p. 27ᵇ; a. fr.
Nidd. 9ᵃ ז׳ one who is past the change of life.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>זְקֵינָתוֹ של זה</he> this man’s (my) ancestress (Sarah); a. e.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:2">Tosef. Shebi. I, 2</cite>; a. e., opp. <cite ref="N00563"><he>נטיעה</he></cite> young plantation.—Pl. <he>זְקֵינוֹת</he>. Y. ib. I, 33ᵇ bot.; a. e.
